expected.foundationDatumNote: Pavement is generally terrain + 1.18 m, shared facade foundation terrain - 0.4 m. Placement uses actual sidewalk samples and first upper pane clearance; do not scale modules to force a fit.

datumContracts.contract: Size=2.00×0.74×1.06 m, Y=[2.36,3.10]. Ground origin must remain; 3.10 is not object height; never recenter minimum Y to zero.
Modern outer size 2.20×1.75×0.24 m with 1.92×1.47 m opening; cedar outer 1.62×1.84×0.16 m with 1.28×1.52 m opening. Bounds do not substitute for opening tests.
Entry outer 1.30×2.50 m, clearance 1.04×2.30 m. Sloped/flat awnings also retain ground origins with respective Ymin 2.37/2.48 m, rather than bases at zero.
At least three actual pavement samples; maximum height spread 0.14 m; threshold=max+0.02 m; preserve upper sill/first-pane clearance and reject elevated parts.

Existing units nominal W=2.20–3.61, D=1.65–2.45 m; H=0.9–1.4 m, first high-rise unit may be 2.5 m. New base datum must be Y=0 with all pipes included in bounds; preserve containment/holes/exclusions and no small domestic/sloped-roof equipment.

Existing near geometry normalized to roughly 1 m and scaled by source height. Near crown width 0.46–0.49×height; far crown radius capped 0.285×height. New 10 m template requires sourceHeight/10 exactly once (22.9 m source => 2.29 scale), not sourceHeight again; species/source clearance may require explicit changes.

Sprigs are approximately 1.25 m-class branch studies, not mature tree templates. Manifest geometry bounds report max Blender Z=1.2 m; preserve that distinction. Ground samples are 2×2 m with 0.1 m rise, not navigation or draped city terrain.

Historic lamp nominal 4.49 m, bench width 2.02 m and seat center 0.48 m, shelter nominal 4.56×2.82×1.86 m. Need actual independent re-exported GLB bounds; do not stretch lamp to arterial-light height.

Legacy body nominal length 12 m/width 2.5 m; mirrors increase width. Wheel center Y=0.52 and radius 0.51 imply tire contact Y≈0.01; runtime adds ground+1.08. New exterior/interior/door/collision must share tire-contact root and explicit legacyToVehicleRoot; do not call old offset floor height.

Nominal car length 17 m, body width 2.65 m, roof cylinder diameter 2.8 m, coupler envelope may extend to 17.8 m. Wheel contact at local Y≈0.02; rail top is path Y=0. New floor/door/platform heights must use explicit rail-contact datum, not body center.

Waterfront columns radius 0.6 m/height 8 m, capitals 1.6×0.35×1.6 m, pediment span 28 m/rise 3.5 m. Marine inner half-width 2.55 m/spring Y3.7/rise 2.82 m; preserve facade datum and collision, do not infer interior access from a visual opening.

Keep declared 1.81 m citizen height and existing 22-bone animated contract. Editable optimization sources are reconstructed from GLB, not original sculpt history; manifest authoring vertices differ from exported seam vertices. Current loader adopts only byte-identical 1024 LOD0; lower LODs remain candidates.

厚木斜窗台、外挑雙端、下緣滴水槽及前鼻倒角；可與雪松窗框配套，但保持各自編輯來源。
